For a blemish to totally go away, I say about a week depending on the size and if you picked at it or not. Does this worsen or better your acne? For me, I saw improvement in my skin. I also ran out of it for about a week and saw that I was breaking out a lot more until I got the gel again. Is it worth the price? I think yes, but there still may be other products out there that are better for acne. Does your acne scare afterwards? In my experience as long as you don't pick at your acne, it won't scare. But we've all made the mistake of picking at it and this gel does seem to help prevent scaring from doing that. Final verdict: I like this gel as it does the job if you're looking to decrease redness and size. But it's not a fast acting treatment option. avis.titre: Learn how to use this retinoid…
avis.texte: I have been using this for 5 years. Best product to fight acne breakouts & wrinkles. I suffered from breakouts on my cheeks & chin (hormonal) honestly this gel helped out with both. I get an occasional breakout but not like I use to. Also I had really bad smile lines, line between my eyebrows & this helped to get rid of it. This works IF you use it properly. NEVER use this on a wet face or freshly moisturized face. Wait at least 10-20 minutes AFTER you have washed and applied moisturizer to your face. If you are using this for the first time I suggest getting Vaseline and applying it around your eyes, nose and corners of mouth before you apply the gel. Apply this only on your forehead, cheeks and chin & spread it around your face & not the immediate eye area. This can be very drying for the first 3 months. So use it at least every other day & progress to everyday. You DO NOT need a lot literally a pea sized amount for your entire face is enough. Also DO NOT use an acid or exfoliate before applying this. It can cause irritation. Use a very basic cleanser like Cerave hydrating cleanser at night & follow with your regular cleanser the next day. Wash your hands after. Please wear sunscreen too.

avis.titre: Works Wonders for Acne, but Made Dry Eye Worse
avis.texte: I'm an adult acne sufferer that primarily gets zits on my chin area. I bought this in the hopes of fighting my hormonal acne and evening out skin tone. In terms of those two things, this product worked wonders! My skin was clear and smooth, and my tone was a lot more even. All great things. But there was one major caveat for me: this made my already sensitive eyes ITCHY and so dry! I already suffer from chronic dry eye syndrome and this product just made things so much worse. I didn't even put it anywhere near my eyes. This is an unfortunate side effect of a lot of retinol products. Retinol can dry out the meibomian glands (oil glands) around the eye and make chronic dry eye a lot worse. This product did exactly that when I used it, causing irritated eyes, and eye strain. So while I absolutely loved what this product did to my skin, I didn't want to cause irrecoverable damage to my eyesight. Therefore I had to return.

I did a ton of research before trying this and you should too. I struggled with texture, large pores, and whiteheads/blackheads when I went off birth control (I am 29 years old). I did a lot of online research (and listened to podcast episodes on Fat Mascara or Breaking Beauty) about retinoids before using this because I was very nervous to try as my skin is sensitive. Based on what I learned from my research I started using this 1 time/week, then 2x/week for 2 weeks, 3x a week for 3 weeks, etc. I experienced some skin sensitivity but otherwise have had all positive effects — better texture, less blackheads and whiteheads, etc. This product is incredible but you have to do your research before trying it. And make sure you switch to a gentle cleanser (before) and reparative moisturizer (after) while using this stuff — and a good sunscreen! Good luck!
Works so well not over drying or irritating for sensitive skin

I've been using this for around 2 1/2 - 3 months and the amount of texture this has minimized is amazing. My pores look smaller and my skin looks super fresh and healthy. The amount of redness this took away, the amount of healing this provided. I am honestly shocked. I haven't had an acne treatment clear my face up so quick before. Even after I had just started using this gel a few go arounds I noticed a huge improvement in my skins texture. Yes my skin did dry out a bit at the very beginning but it went away quickly after my skin had gotten adjusted to the continued use of the product. I highly recommend!! You may dry out/break out a little at the beginning but just trust the process. I had purchased this gel almost a year before I had began using it and to be honest, I wish I had started it sooner. I guess I myself was a bit nervous incorporating this into my routine but I'm glad I did.

Retinol treatments, while great, are serious treatments. They can be irritating, cause purging(skin gets worse before better), and dry your skin out. Use only as directed and WEAR SUNSCREEN EVERY DAY. Everyone should wear sunscreen, but retinol makes your skin much more sensitive to sun. If you are not responsible enough to wear sunscreen with retinols, don't use them. This product is great when used appropriately. I use it as a young adult and my mom uses it with mature skin. Great for everyone!

it's a very good product. I use when I have a huge pimple coming out. Clears it and minimizes it. It is not for everyday use. It was dry your skin out. It is a TREATMENT for a reason. If you use it wrong it won't work for you and you'll damage your skin. I recommend this product!
Works great. Notice results in days. Son had acne problems and started using this and noticed face clearing days after starting.

avis.titre: You need to do some research first.
avis.texte: This is a fantastic product. However if you naively put on your face without doing any research on retinoids, you're setting yourself up for failure. Do not start off by putting this on your face every night. I don't know how to say that any clearer lol. Start with one night a week and GRADUALLY build up. It can have some side effects, especially if you use it too frequently too soon. Those being increased skin sensitivity and dryness. Stick with a basic gentle cleanser and gentle moisturizer, you'll get through it. Also, don't mix it with other actives the same night you're using it. You're just asking for dry sensitive skin issues at that point. Last, you have to protect your skin with SPF. That's like a pretty general rule but *especially* with Retinoids.
I was recommended this product but unfortunately it didn't do anything for my skin:(

avis.titre: Acne still bad after four months, caused sensitive skin
avis.texte: I had high hopes this product would help with my persistent adult acne, including cystic nodules especially around my period. I was prepared for the initial "purge" and my acne did indeed get worse before it got a bit better, but only moderately better and my skin seemed to keep on purging after several months. I used this acne treatment gel nightly on a clean face, followed a few minutes later by moisturizer. I stuck with it for four months but found it wasn't getting any better. I've since switched to a different retinoid that seems to be helping much more. I also found my skin became much more sensitive while using this acne treatment gel, even to gentle touch - it wasn't so sensitive that I would have stopped using it if it cleared up my acne, but I am enjoying no longer having that sensitivity since I stopped using this product.

avis.titre: You have to give it time!
avis.texte: Adapelene really can do wonders but it's going to get worse before it gets better. What's off-putting is that if you're skin is acne prone and you have a lot of underlying acne that hasn't made it to the surface, it's going to get MUCH worse before it gets better. Your skin is going to purge all the underlying acne. My skin purged like crazy using adapelene 0.3% prescribed by my derm. It took three months for my skin to begin clearing from the purging, so you really don't see the full affect of this product until 6 months, but when you do it's worth it! I only get a few breakouts every now and then. This product can be irritating, you really only need a pea sized amount for your entire face. Seriously don't use more even if you have bad skin, it will only irritate your skin!
it made my skin look better that is ever looked before! if you buy this you will see results in a short amount of time

avis.titre: Mix with 2.5% BP to get Rx Epi duo
avis.texte: I combine this product with 2.5% benzoyl peroxide to make a very expensive Rx strength treatment that kills the bacteria and exfoliates/cleans the pores. I use the Neutrogena stubborn acne am treatment with micronized BP and this brand of adapal ene gel. I started by applying it to my jawline and chin every couple days to build a tolerance since these are very drying products. Now i can use them every evening as a preventative measure. I so wish I had tried this combo when I was in my teens and twenties. Luckily proactiv came out and the cleanser and toner cleared up my teenage inflamed skin. It's all about finding the right products for you. Reducing your intake of refined sugar, dairy, fried foods and salt while upping your consumption of filtered water, fruits & veggies should improve everyone's skin to varying degrees. Then there are some people who can do and eat whatever they want and their skin stays clear and smooth.

avis.titre: Finally, a product that does something!
avis.texte: I have been using this probably a month and a half now and I am so glad I stuck with it!!! Some background.... I had pretty decent skin until I got pregnant with my daughter in 2018. Almost immediately my skin became a nightmare for me, lots of breakouts around my chin and cheeks, no doubt hormonal. My skin got oilier and pores larger. I thought that my skin would revert back once I gave birth. Hahaha, joke was on me. The past almost 3 years I have dealt with the exact same issues as when I was pregnant and have tried a ton of products. I sat on my tube of this for probably a month because I was scared it would be too much for my skin as it can react strongly to things. Finally I took the plunge. I would just use the teeniest layer all over my face and moisturize well. Initially my skin did get pretty sensitive. When I noticed it reacting to things with a burning sensation I would lay off this product for 2-3 days and moisturize well and then resume usage. Slowly things started happening. I stopped getting the breakouts on my chin. Then other areas improved. My skin started feeling soooo soft. The look of my pores reduced. My skin looked younger. Some stuff deep in my pores started to clear up. It took a good month to start to see these changes but I am so glad I stuck with it. This has been the only product that has actually changed my skin for the better!!!

This stuff really works IF YOU USE IT PROPERLY. You're literally only supposed to use a tiny pea-sized amount for your entire face. So I put a dot on my finger and distribute it around my face before massaging it in. It absorbs pretty fast. Right after I put it on (like a minute later) I apply a pretty heavy moisturizer. This stuff is super drying so following with moisture is essential. Let me tell you, I used to use like a nickel-sized amount ANS no moisturizer after....my face would feel like it's peeling off. So don't do that. It also damages your skin and causes more breakouts. As long as you use this product correctly, it really helps cystic, hormonal, and stubborn acne.
